get_white_noise: generate a random white noise tensor with specified channels and frame count using PyTorch
get_batch_white_noise: generate a batch of random white noise tensors with specified batch size, channels, and frames
save_wav: save a 2D audio tensor to disk as a WAV, MP3, OGG, or FLAC file with clipping strategy
test_get_white_noise: test the get_white_noise function by generating random audio tensors with varying channel and frame counts
refactor_save_wav: refactor the save_wav function to support additional audio formats or normalization strategies
